data.narrative:
Kvertus is a Growth-stage defense and security company founded by Yaroslav Filimonov and Andrii Znaichenko, having raised approximately $130M to date. The Defense & Security sector includes 10 identified comparables (2 public, 8 private), with notable peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-to-next-stage transitions, anchored to the $130M total raised as a valuation proxy, yielding $156M. A traditional Peer-Median analysis is not viable: while 23 same-sector comps exist in the broader Defense & Security universe, none meet the narrow criteria of matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier simultaneously, creating insufficient datapoints (minimum three required) for reliable cross-sectional analysis.

The triangulation, constrained to one method, supports a median valuation of $156M, with a low estimate of $133M and high estimate of $179M reflecting ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. The primary uncertainty is the absence of stage-matched peer benchmarking; stronger validation would require either tighter peer comparables at the Growth stage or disclosed revenue/margin metrics to support revenue multiple or profitability-adjusted approaches. The current range should be treated as provisional pending additional comparable data or operational disclosure.
